_readme: All the dialogue in the game lives in this file. You can edit it without touching any code.
A scene has an id, a start node, and a bag of nodes. Each node has:
speaker  - whose name shows above the text. Leave it out for narration.
choices  - 2 to 4 options. Each has text, and goto (the id of the next node).
effects  - optional. { cash, heat, cred, built, took, flags } applied when chosen.
end      - true if the scene finishes here.
built and took are hidden from the player and decide the ending.
Built goes up when he makes something or looks after someone.
Took goes up when he takes a shortcut.

arrive.speaker: Slick
arrive.text: Don't come round the back, Ini. Front door's for customers and the back door's for us, and you're neither this week.

minus_twenty.speaker: Slick
minus_twenty.text: It's minus twenty for everyone. Rest of us are inside because we turned up when we said we would.

wait_him_out.text: He doesn't fill the silence. He just looks at you, and lets it sit, and you understand that he's already had this conversation in his head and you're only here to hear the end of it.

keep_waiting.speaker: Slick
keep_waiting.text: You're better at this than you used to be. Fine. You're out. Not this week — out.

say_it_properly.speaker: Slick
say_it_properly.text: You're out of the Frostbite Boys. That properly enough?

come_on.speaker: Slick
come_on.text: I've come on. I came on for two years. Ask me what the last thing you finished was.

had_a_thing.speaker: Slick
had_a_thing.text: You always have a thing. That's the whole problem, Ini — you've got a thing every single time, and every one of them is true, and none of them are the reason.

my_crew_too.speaker: Slick
my_crew_too.text: It was. Then Tuesday happened, and it stopped being.

the_job.speaker: Slick
the_job.text: You weren't late. You didn't come. Kez stood on the corner of Glacier and Third for an hour and a half in the open, on his own, holding something he shouldn't have been holding, waiting for a lookout who was at home.

is_he_alright.speaker: Slick
is_he_alright.text:
…He's fine. He's shaken. He's nineteen.

That's the first thing you've asked me tonight that wasn't about you.

nobody_got_picked_up.speaker: Slick
nobody_got_picked_up.text: No. Nobody got picked up. That's luck, and you're standing there spending it like you earned it.

so_it_worked_out.speaker: Slick
so_it_worked_out.text:
Yeah. It worked out.

Go home, Ini.

i_know.speaker: Slick
i_know.text: I know you know. That's what makes it worse. You knew on Tuesday and you still didn't come.

not_fair.speaker: Slick
not_fair.text: It's completely fair. You just don't like it. Those are different things and you've spent your whole life mixing them up.

the_reason.speaker: Slick
the_reason.text:
Everyone on this block has a thing they're going to do. Bruno's opening a place. Marla's going back to school. You're going to be a rapper.

Difference is, the rest of them turn up to work while they wait.

the_tape.speaker: Slick
the_tape.text:
I've heard four minutes of it. Same four minutes for eight months.

And Ini — those four minutes are good. That's not me being kind. They're actually good. Which is why I stopped being able to watch this.

never_said_that.speaker: Slick
never_said_that.text:
No. I didn't. Because you'd have taken it as permission to keep not finishing it.

I'm saying it now because you're not mine to manage any more.

choices.text: "That's a rough way to hear it."

help_me_finish.speaker: Slick
help_me_finish.text: I'm not your manager, I'm a guy who moves boxes off a pier. Go see Fathom under the boardwalk. He'll keep the booth unlocked for you, which is more than I'd do right now.

choices.text: "I don't need a lecture, I need work."

doesnt_pay_rent.speaker: Slick
doesnt_pay_rent.text:
No. It doesn't. Neither does standing here.

Kodi's people are on the boardwalk most nights, if that's the road you want. Don't tell them I said so.

sending_me_to_kodi.speaker: Slick
sending_me_to_kodi.text: I'm not sending you anywhere. I'm telling you where the door is, because you're going to find it anyway and I'd rather you found it with your eyes open.

a_joke.speaker: Slick
a_joke.text: No. A joke would be easier. I'd have laughed at a joke two years ago and we'd still be talking.

what_am_i.speaker: Slick
what_am_i.text: You're the most talented person I know and I can't have you standing next to me when it goes wrong. Both of those are true. I've stopped trying to make them fit.

youre_right.speaker: Slick
youre_right.text:
…

Don't do that. Don't agree with me, it makes this harder.

You're still out.

make_it_right.speaker: Slick
make_it_right.text: There's nothing to make right. That's what I keep telling you. Nobody's owed anything, there's no job you can do to fix Tuesday. It's just over.

okay_dignity.speaker: Slick
okay_dignity.text:
He waits, like he expected more. When it doesn't come, something in his face goes worse, not better.

"Take care of yourself, Ini. I mean that."

end_walked.text:
The back door shuts. The fryer noise goes with it, and then it's just the hum of the sign and the cold coming up through your shoes.

Rent is due Friday. You have no crew, no girlfriend, and four good minutes of a song nobody has heard.

end_begged.speaker: Slick
end_begged.text:
He lets you get about six words in. Then he puts a flipper on the door and stops, without turning round.

"Don't. Please. Let one of us walk away from this with something."

end_walked_quiet.text:
The back door shuts. You stand in the alley a while longer than you need to.

Rent is due Friday. You have no crew, no girlfriend, and four good minutes of a song nobody has heard.

end_threatened.speaker: Slick
end_threatened.text:
That's the first thing you've said tonight that sounded like somebody else. Kodi, probably. You've been on the boardwalk.

"Go home before you say the second one."

end_walked_angry.text:
The back door shuts harder than it needs to. Somewhere down the block a Seal cruiser rolls past the mouth of the alley, slow, the way they do when they've got nowhere to be.

Rent is due Friday.

locked.text:
Her light is on. You can hear a textbook page turn, which means she's revising, which means she has work in six hours.

You don't knock. Not tonight, not like this.

hello.speaker: Tuck
hello.text:
Ini! Ini. Hey. Did they do you as well?

He is sitting on an upturned crate eating chips out of the bag with a flipper, entirely unbothered, wearing one glove.

glove.speaker: Tuck
glove.text: Long story. Good story. Bad ending for the glove.

out_too.speaker: Tuck
out_too.text:
Yeah! Well — I walked. Slick said you were done and I said then I'm done and he said fine and I said fine, and then I was outside.

He holds out the bag.

"I've been thinking about it a lot since and I do think I moved too fast."

chip.speaker: Tuck
chip.text:
So what do we do now?

He says WE like it was never a question, and it's the warmest thing that's happened to you all week.

shouldnt.speaker: Tuck
shouldnt.text:
Probably not! Bit late though.

So what do we do now?
